borders.name: hairline

borders.name: dashed
borders.purpose: Drop zones, empty states, make-up workdays, user-changed days, placement guides.

borders.name: focus-ring
borders.purpose: Every focusable element; ink in light mode, yellow in dark mode (the landing layout uses its own ink at 3px offset).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover background, border and colour changes.

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Arrivals: drawer rise, slip straightening, arrow slides (landing --nb-ease).

motion.name: deal
motion.value: GSAP fromTo y 96 -> 0 with extra tilt -> resting tilt, 1.1s expo.out, stagger .14s
motion.purpose: Hero slips deal in once on load; cheque wording wipes in (clip-path, .9s power3.inOut), holiday days pop (back.out(2.2)), BMI counts up (1.2s expo.out).

motion.name: demo-on-enter
motion.purpose: Each category demo plays once: cut-out reveal 1.2s, signature DrawSVG 1.8s, BMI marker 1.4s expo.out, wheel 3s power4.out.

motion.name: settle-fallback
motion.purpose: If the script stalls, every slip and demo settles to its finished state.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: gsap.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)"); CSS reduce collapses animation and transition to .01ms
motion.purpose: Reduced motion shows every end state; GSAP is never downloaded.

narrative.overview:
toolsliang is drawn on white paper with a near-black pen. Every container is closed by a 2px ink rule, every category owns one flat sticker colour, and nothing floats: there are no shadows, no gradients and no blur. The world is neo-brutalist in material and calm in hierarchy: big heavy headings, one message per block, and few words. The landing page shows each category's real output (a cheque wording, a holiday run, a BMI reading, a cut-out portrait, a signed form, a wheel result) instead of describing it. Tool pages keep the same materials and become a focused, ruled workspace.

Density is medium. The landing page breathes at display scale. The App Shell (sidebar, directory, tool pages) is denser: 44px controls, 8–16px gaps, and one ruled card per tool with its sub-sections separated by hairlines rather than nested frames. Dark mode inverts only the ground, the surfaces and the rules. The category fills and the ink set on them stay the same in both themes.

Motion is an enhancement that only replays how a finished state was reached. Every demo renders its end state in HTML. GSAP loads lazily on the landing page only and plays each sequence once inside `gsap.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)')`.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink text, and a 2px ink rule on every container. A 1px hairline separates sections inside a ruled container.
Five flat category fills that never invert, always with ink on them.
Sun yellow is the single highlight colour: hover, selected, text selection, the hero mark.
Pills for pressable controls, with a radius ladder of 12 / 16 / 20 / 28px for containers.
Heavy 800-weight headings with tight tracking. Archivo Variable leads every font stack, and Chinese falls through to each platform's system face.
Zero shadows. Depth comes from rules, fills, overlap and ink inversion.

rules.name: The Fills Don't Invert Rule
rules.body: Category fills and the ink on them are identical in light and dark mode. Only ground, surface, text and rules invert. Text on a fill is always `ink-950` (7:1 or better on every fill).

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the only interaction colour. Hover, selected and highlighted states use it, and the four other fills never signal interaction state. Components reference semantic tokens (`--color-*`, `--fill-*`, `--button-*`), never primitives or raw hex.

rules.name: The Meaning Twice Rule
rules.body: Colour never carries meaning alone. A holiday cell also has its text mark and accessible name. Errors and warnings pair the colour with an icon, a 2px border and words.

rules.name: The Heavy Heading Rule
rules.body: Every h1–h3 is 800 weight with -0.02em to -0.035em tracking. `main.css` re-asserts this after Tailwind preflight resets heading weight.

rules.name: The Punctuation Break Rule
rules.body: Chinese headings and lead copy use `word-break: keep-all` with `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, so lines break at punctuation and never inside a phrase. Headlines also use `text-wrap: balance`.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small label sits above a heading. A heading stands on its own, and supporting copy goes below it.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow` is used for elevation, ever. If something needs to stand out, give it a rule, a fill, or invert it to ink.

rules.name: The Ruled-Once Rule
rules.body: A tool gets one ruled card. Notes, caveats, legends, sources and model panels inside it are sections under a 1px `border-subtle` hairline, with no border, radius or background of their own. Tables keep a hairline frame because they are data, not cards.

rules.name: The Pill Press Rule
rules.body: Pressable controls are pills. Text inputs and selects are 12px, and the search field is the one input drawn as a pill. Container radius grows with container size: 12, then 16, then 20, then 28px.

dos: Do close every surface with the 2px `--rule` in `--color-border`, and separate sections inside it with a 1px `--color-border-subtle` hairline.
Do set ink (`--fill-ink`) on every category fill, and keep fills unchanged in dark mode.
Do use yellow (`--color-surface-hover`) as the hover and selected fill on pointer devices only (`@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`). In dark mode it resolves to Deep Yellow.
Do mark the current location by inverting to ink (`--sidebar-active-bg` / `-fg`).
Do make buttons, search fields, option toggles and badges full pills, and keep text inputs at 12px.
Do keep a visible 3px focus outline at a 2–3px offset on everything focusable.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44×44px.
Do render every demo or animated value in its finished state in HTML, and animate only inside `gsap.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)')`, once.
Do show a category's real output in place of describing it on the landing page.
donts: Don't add `box-shadow`, drop shadows, glows, glass blur, or decorative gradients. The only gradient in the system is the functional transparency checkerboard.
Don't nest a 2px-ruled card inside another ruled card. Use a hairline section instead.
Don't use any of the four non-yellow fills to signal hover, selection or focus.
Don't put a small eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
Don't let colour carry meaning alone. Pair it with text, an icon or a border.
Don't paint the light-mode sidebar as a full black panel. Only the current item is inverted.
Don't scale, float, parallax, scroll-jack or pointer-follow. Landing demos play once and stop.
Don't load a CJK webfont or any third-party font CDN.
Don't use emoji or Unicode symbols as icons. Use Lucide outline icons or the landing's own SVG drawings.
